meta.title: Large schedule
meta.description: 240 items over three shifts: the size the package’s performance budget is measured at.

scenario: 240 items across the thirty-six hours the three shifts cover. It is the size the package measures itself at, and it is deliberately more than a person would read: what is being shown is that the component still behaves at that size, not that a day should look like this.
look: Every item is rendered. The schedule does not virtualize, so what you scroll past is really in the page.
The column cap does the work in the busy hours; without it the timeline would be unreadable long before 240 items.
The list view groups the same 240 items by shift, which is the faster way to read a day this full.
Switching the view, the scheme or the density re-lays out all of them at once.
uses: <link to="/overflow/">Overflow</link> — what keeps a crowded hour readable at this size.
<link to="/list-view/">List view</link> — the view for a long day.
<link to="/data-modes-and-ssr/">Data modes and SSR</link> — where items come from, and what the component does while they are on their way.
